titleAr: حدد وسائل الدفع وافتح المتجر للناس
titleEn: Choose payment methods and go live

undo.note: yes: store can be set back via settings; going live is reversible by super-admin status only

ar: ليه مش قادر اعمل go live؟
محتاج اعمل ايه قبل ما انشر المتجر
en: How do I publish my store?

steps: Finish the setup guide items, pick COD/InstaPay/cards, press go-live.
edgeCases: Go-live gate refuses until required setup items pass or (InstaPay subscription path) a super-admin confirmed payment (EBDA-FUNNEL-9)
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Concurrency: preview carries the etag/version read; if data changed before apply the assistant re-previews instead of applying
Suspended store is read-only (billing suspension): writes fail, assistant must explain and link Billing
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
gaps: InstaPay subscription payment requires super-admin confirmation today (audit gap 3, BLOCKER); AI auto-confirm is designed (self-service spec 7.4) but NOT BUILT
